editorial.blurb: An intimate, hidden gem beef omakase where Chef Park elevates Korean flavors with meticulous craftsmanship and impeccable service in a 12-seat tasting-menu-only setting.
editorial.insiderTip: Book during Restaurant Week for an accessible entry point to the full experience, and allow time for all courses including dessert—the matcha bingsu and pastries from pastry chef Alana are standout finales worth savoring.
